items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: we were given a chance by Mr. Jacques Canetti, to record for Brunswick.

ctx.x:
Well, he signed a contract with Canetti, and Canetti take him on a tour.

And immediately I had a wire from Canetti asking me -- could I come immediately. And I didn't answer.

It happened that he also left Canetti. Whatever happened, it was a question of money.

But when I saw Pete, when Pete came back to Paris, he said -- well, I'm glad -- well, I explained to him that I'd gotten a wire from Canetti and everything, and he wasn't aware of it, he didn't know anything about it.
